summary: DEFSEC Technologies filed a Form 6-K furnishing a news release dated October 20, 2026, providing a routine corporate update. Disclosures include preliminary unaudited cash and cash equivalents of approximately $7.7 million and $0 debt as of September 30, 2026, versus $3.5 million cash at June 30, 2026, reflecting August 2026 equity offering proceeds; 4,593,998 common shares outstanding and 24,575 pre-funded warrants remaining. The release covers BLISS laser-detection demonstrations at Dugway, an ARWEN business development and cross-selling strategy, and conference participation. No transaction, board recommendation, advisor, or special-situations mechanics are present; no risk-arb angle exists.
